text: The tooltip checks percentage independently of status, with a null guard and strict numeric0/100 branches. The new task sets42 with no STATUS and directly checks the tooltip text. A later timer yield and historical Try reports are separate evidence, and no test or provider operation ran.
title: Task tooltip percentage no longer requires STATUS and its test uses local storage
